authority.grant_scope_requested: Re-bind the standing persistent MCP dashboard product runtime to Host build 4a735bab2fafe86001006d8277481b553f41c299e04c31462a72d0f3caf42112. That build changes only the streaming_ack_clock profile (its own Host-owned ceiling of 1800 s / 45000 frames, so a webcam launch is one connection) and bounds the per-session ACK list to the latest 500 entries; it is also built commit-independent. Dashboard behaviour, target, pacing (activity profile: 150 ms floor, 900 s / 500 frames), budgets, reconnect/reclaim semantics and the absence of raw-send/target-selection are all unchanged from Runtime 003. Grants no streaming authority: the streaming_ack_clock profile requires its own reviewed manifest and grant, or the separately granted webcam product policy.
authority.revocation: runtime/wsl/install_openditoo_product.sh --uninstall stops/disables product service, restores prior collector state, and moves a revoked policy record under .openditoo-local/revoked/

behavior.collector_ownership: product runtime collects while connected and while backing off; standalone collector timer is transactionally disabled and restored on uninstall

build.host_note: Runtime 004 trusts the Host build that gives the streaming_ack_clock profile its own 1800 s / 45000-frame ceiling (was the shared 900 s / 500) and keeps only the latest 500 ACKs per session. Activity-profile limits and every dashboard number are byte-for-byte the same code path; Python supervisor code is unchanged, so runtime_revision stays 2.

description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build. Runtime 004 re-binds the policy to the Host build with a separate streaming-profile ceiling.

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

session.renewal: fresh unique Host session after lifetime/budget; displayed frame persists across brief socket rollover
